Account summary: enterprise insurance R&D org evaluating Redwood Dedicated for high-throughput claims automation and policy QA. Key stakeholders: CTO (Elaine Park) - infra lead; Head of AI (Rahul Menon) - model/ops; Procurement lead (Lisa Ortega). AE Jordan Kim and SE Priya Banerjee leading POC. CSM Marco Silva on standby for post-contract ops.

Recent timeline / activities:
- 2026-01-20: Intro call (AE demo) — high level; capture use cases and compliance needs.
- 2026-02-04: Technical deep-dive (SE + infra) — discussed VPC tunneling, KMS integration, nightly audit exports. Fireflies: FF-2026-02-18-4042.
- 2026-02-15: POC kickoff — 2-week test using dedicated fraction of g4dn-like pool; baseline with LLaMA-variant and a private finetune for policy Q&A.
- 2026-02-25: POC interim review — observed 95th percentile latency ~ 210ms for short chat (64 tokens) on 1 GPU with continuous batching; throughput capped at ~180 reqs/min under default batching. SE notes quantization tradeoffs: 8-bit stable for quality, 4-bit gives 1.7x throughput but needs retuning for some scoring models.
- 2026-03-02: Model tuning workshop — focused on context length and KV cache configuration for multi-message claim dialogs. Fireflies: FF-2026-03-02-4921.

Technical findings & preference notes (from SE/POC):
- Latency SLO target: P95 < 250ms for chat flows (64-128 tokens), P95 < 400ms for 512-token summarization.
- Throughput target: baseline 300 rps tokens-equivalent (sustained) across peak windows; planned spike allowance via burst pool.
- GPU sizing: recommend 4x A10p-equivalent reserved for baseline (estimated 12k tokens/s combined) with burst capacity (2x) during peak batch windows. Customer asks formal reserved GPU commit schedule with monthly cadence and overage pricing.
- Model tuning: prefer context length cap at 2k for production; enable prefix KV caching per session to keep repeated dialogues sub-100ms incremental latency.
- Quantization: plan for mixed profiles — int8 for general generation, 4-bit (q4_0/q4_k) for inference-heavy embed/rerank models after QA. Need Redwood Optimize suggestions mapped to our workloads.
- Batching/KV: continuous batching helps cost but must be tuned per route; SE recommends adaptive batching with max-latency ceiling 50ms and hot-route bypass for low-latency policy checks.

Security/compliance notes:
- Must support SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning.
- Audit logs (token-level) for 180 days required.
- Data residency: primary US region; wil require contractual language on in-flight data handling for claims PII.

Commercial / SLA negotiations:
- Customer requested explicit throughput guarantees (tokens/sec) and latency SLOs tied to credits/penalties. Legal provided initial redlines (see drive doc). Procurement pushing for a 12-month reserved commitment with quarterly reviews.
- Pricing ask: ability to convert committed GPU hours into overage credits; discount tiers if usage exceeds baseline by sustained 20% over 3 months.
